Please perform the required actual CAL-01–05 source/API acceptance review for TAC-01-ORDINARY-MAGICAL-ACTIVITY. The owner resumed the full engine goal; runtime edits are still held until this exact contract is accepted and Codex concurs. Your previous response b5c97981-b381-5551-9bd0-1bdc52f7d12c was retained as a proposal, not acceptance.

Published to Engine: 7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11 (14 documentation files only; engine tree unchanged 6cce215d2ce46bebcfd15f69f61dc324545c23d7). Exact contract: https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/7c084e96db51d74b48ec57a207c7ceaf221e4c11/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-tac01-ordinary-magic/SOURCE_API_CONTRACT.md ; SHA256 bf565dfce8661dae67df214a8b5fd736c845ad06074622ad758f82fa9faf239d. Adjacent README, SOURCE_BINDINGS.json (48 exact verified source/API bindings), PROFILE_AVAILABILITY.json, SOURCE_API_AUDIT.md and EVIDENCE_ROUTE_PLAN.md supply the evidence. Schema116/prefix TEST_ONLY.ordinary-magical-activity-v1- checked available; not yet assigned in runtime.

Codex agrees in principle with your preserved tactical-End / ordinary full-allowance / carried-lineage proposal, including the explicitly delegated new restrictions: no paid Grounding after its settlement opportunity was consumed, and shortened carry earns no idle reduction but retains eligible paid Grounding PB once. The complete written contract is now the review object. It adds explicit zero-effect consumed status, restricted sparse zero-idle ranges (eight-hour rest cannot allocate4800 old End rows), separate immutable origin/current context, independent per-command producer cadence, real origin for Rite/Radiance records, and recharge use provenance so pre-first-new-Start use cannot count old virtual/pre-use ticks. Sanctuary turn validation stays separate. All six consumers are covered.

Independent read-only source review identified and the draft includes: admission index0 Start executes before InventoryCombat flips; closure can refresh before flipping outside; explicit first replacement Start boundary must beat the captured deadline during sparse advance; real skipped retreat Starts excluded; PostRecovery OwnsEvent validators must distinguish current context from carried origin; Grounding payment is receipt+actual PayAction replay, not a nonexistent standalone record; true reinforcement bootstrap origin authorizes no casting/idle entitlement. A genuine positive carried outside use requires actual early closure before Cleric first Start, not merely a carried record. Potential Ferry Hero→Ferry→Cleric first-slot kill remains an unproved route, with finite investigation/allocation required if blocked.

One explicit source integration clarification: base Healing Rite at actual supported Cleric1 after real reinforcement closure must not require earned Cleric2/Radiance merely because the old fixture gate did. Actual Rite grant/Action2RP/target/condition/context checks remain; unowned requested Radiance cure rejects, no passive rider appears. Contract requires genuine C1 pre-advancement witness and denial.

CAL04 binds actual existing dispatcher insertion points instead of broadly reordering work/life/rest. OMA04 comparison for different advance command partitions uses canonical gameplay projection plus ordered mechanical events/RNG, retaining different receipt histories; the five identical-logical-sequence paths still require full canonical equality. Please explicitly resolve/accept these source/API and evidence precision changes or identify concrete blockers. No runtime/gameplay/test claim, no predecessor acceptance reopened, no Unity/production authority. All1587 predecessor cases and genuine five-path/new-runtime/compatibility obligations remain for implementation qualification. Please review and state exact bounded source/API disposition so I can implement; do not implement or run tests on your side.
